notablePrerequisites: Pollenbright Wings attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Pollenbright Wings attached.
Pollenbright Wings triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If the creature has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.
